countedBy: lane #187 (opus) from the rectified SE panorama crop TMX7316010203-002193_pano_0000_004912 (2021, 16.1 px/m, artifacts/landmark-briefs/kraanspoor/w02-128.alt.jpg) and the SW head-on Commons photo; ribbon convention. Not a blind haiku count; the integrator may re-count. The glass box above the track is not declared: its glass louvre skin breaks the curtain wall into 0.9 m strips in any elevation, so storey counts there measure the louvres, not windows.
